subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should the first public account feed contract preserve existing personal-publisher legacy resolution before merge, or intentionally ship as ownerPublisherId-only?
rationale: This is a new public API surface, and current main still supports legacy linked-user and ownerUserId personal-publisher paths that the PR does not preserve.

options.title: Preserve compatibility before merge
options.body: Require the PR to reuse or match current personal-publisher fallback behavior and include regression coverage before publishing the route.

options.title: Ship the narrower contract
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally define account feeds as ownerPublisherId-only, but that should be an explicit compatibility decision.

options.title: Pause for discovery contract review
options.body: Hold this PR until the account feed and adjacent registry/export bridge contracts settle together.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility before merge
recommendation.body: Require the PR to reuse or match current personal-publisher fallback behavior and include regression coverage before publishing the route.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest history-backed owner for the existing personal-publisher compatibility behavior.
